name: Logos
title: Logos
summary: The ISM and dot.Bible logos, marks and brand patterns, with the rules for placing them on light and dark surfaces.
whenToUse: Use the **ISM full logo** in the site header, footer, print covers and email headers.
Use the **ISM mark** where space is tight: favicons, avatars, app tiles for ISM itself, social profile images.
Use the **dot.Bible full logo** wherever the dot.Bible app is the subject (app banners, store pages, app promos). Use the **dot.Bible icon** for the app tile and small placements.
Use the **patterns** (Circle-symbol-1, Dots 1–5) as quiet background texture on campaign, print and hero art. Never behind body text.
whenNotToUse: Do not redraw, recolour, stretch, outline or add effects to any logo.

anatomy.description: All logo files are drawn in black ink. On dark surfaces invert them with a filter; do not use the "White" files (they render black). CSS custom properties for the files ship in `tokens/logos.css`: `--logo-full-black`, `--logo-mark-black`, `--logo-dotbible-full-black`, `--logo-dotbible-mark-black` (use with `background-image` / `mask-image`).

props.name: variant
props.description: Which logo file to show: ISM full logo, ISM mark, dot.Bible full logo or dot.Bible icon.

props.name: inverse
props.description: Place on a dark surface: applies `filter: brightness(0) invert(1)` so the black ink turns white.

props.name: src
props.description: Base path of the logo files (no trailing slash needed).

props.name: height
props.description: Height in px. Full logo 28-40 in headers, 24-32 in footers; mark at least 24; dot.Bible icon at least 32.

props.name: alt
props.description: Accessible name. Defaults to the brand name; when the logo is a home link make it the destination, for example "ISM home".

props.name: surface
props.description: Surface the logo sits on. `light` gives black ink, `dark` gives white ink. Defaults to the theme scheme.

props.name: clearSpace
props.description: Keep the clear space (a quarter of the logo height) around the logo free of other content.

props.name: tile
props.description: Put the dot.Bible icon on a white tile with `radius-md`, as in app tiles. Only applies to `dotbible-icon`.

props.name: enforceMinSize
props.description: Clamp the height up to the minimum size for the logo (ISM mark 24, dot.Bible icon 32, full logos 28).

variantNotes: **Ink:** black on `--white` / `--off-white` / `--gray-100`; white (inverted) on `--black`, `--charcoal-900` and on dark photography or `--gradient-signature`.
**Size:** full logo 28–40px tall in headers, 24–32px in footers; mark at least 24px; dot.Bible icon at least 32px.
**Patterns:** Circle-symbol-1 (ring; Circle-symbol-2 is an identical copy) at 6–20% opacity on dark, 4–10% on light; Dots 1–5 (PNG) as a corner or edge texture on light surfaces.

`Pattern1.svg`, `Pattern2.svg` and `Circle-symbol-3.svg` were exported without their styles and render as solid shapes. Do not use them until they are re-exported; build the ring motif from Circle-symbol-1 or inline SVG circles.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Clear space around every logo = the height of the mark's inner circle (about a quarter of the logo height). No text, buttons or edges inside it.
One logo per view. Never place ISM and dot.Bible full logos side by side except on a "from ISM" endorsement line, where the ISM logo is smaller.
Never place a logo on a busy photo without a dark overlay (`--black` at 40%+).
Never colour a logo Horizon Blue or a gradient. Logos are black or white only.
In app tiles, the dot.Bible icon sits on a white tile with `--radius-md`.

content: Write the names as **International Scripture Ministries** (or **ISM** after first use) and **dot.Bible** (lowercase d, capital B).
